class.description: Base class for any object that keeps a reference count. [Resource] and many other helper objects inherit this class.

class.name: Node
class.brief_description: Base class for all scene objects.
class.description: Nodes are Godot's building blocks. They can be assigned as the child of another node.

method.name: add_child
method.description: Adds a child [param node]. Nodes can have any number of children.

method.name: get_parent
method.description: Returns the parent node of the current node, or [code]null[/code] when the node has no parent.

members.member: The name of the node. Names must be unique among siblings.

signal.name: ready
signal.description: Emitted when the node is ready.

method.description: Returns a [Resource] from the file system at compile time.
